Done. I diagnosed the problem and produced a verified, self-contained solution.

## Deliverables
- `~/systemd-logind-busctl-timeout-signal-storm.md` — the full solution/runbook
- `~/bunker-logind-probe.sh` — corrected shell textfile probe (validated)
- `~/bunker-logind-probe.go` — corrected Go probe (validated)

## What I verified
- **The probe bug is real and reproducible on this host:**
  - `busctl introspect org.freedesktop.login1` → `Too few arguments.` rc=1 (usage error on *every* host, healthy or wedged)
  - `busctl introspect org.freedesktop.login1 /org/freedesktop/login1` → reaches the bus (fails only because this build host has no system bus)
  - The binary's own help confirms signature: `introspect SERVICE OBJECT [INTERFACE]`
- **Fixed artifacts:**
  - `shellcheck` OK, `bash -n` OK, probe runs and emits correct `bunker_logind_up`/`bunker_logind_failed_units`
  - `go vet` OK, `go build` OK, Go probe runs and emits the same gauges
- **Env cross-check:** Alloy config at `/etc/fleet-monitoring/config.alloy` already collects `/var/lib/node_exporter/textfile`, so no collector change is needed.

## Root cause (short)
CI transient-unit churn (`user@`, `user-runtime-dir@`, `bunker-docker-*`) emits ~300 Hz `systemd1` `UnitRemoved`/`PropertiesChanged` signals. `systemd-logind`'s single-threaded dispatch loop drains that one socket (~3700 epoll iterations/12s) and stops answering D-Bus method calls — so `busctl`/`loginctl` time out while the unit still shows `active`. The monitoring probe's one-arg `busctl introspect` then compounded it by being a guaranteed false positive.

## Fix
1. **Immediate:** `systemctl reset-failed` + `systemctl restart systemd-logind`, then confirm with two-arg probes.
2. **Durable:** correct probe (two-arg + timeouts + atomic textfile write), isolate/reduce runner churn, bound `NFailedUnits` with a `reset-failed` timer, and alert on `bunker_logind_up == 0` / `bunker_logind_failed_units > 200`.

The doc includes exact commands, complete drop-in units, the full probe code, and a verification section mapping to the recorded witnesses (`<email>:9090`, `strace-fd15-3709epoll`, `dbus-monitor-UnitRemoved-storm`).

signatures.description: Symptom: busctl/loginctl calls to org.freedesktop.login1 time out while systemctl shows the unit active/running; recurred 4x in one day on a CI runner host (bunker-mvp) with shrinking inter-wedge intervals. Root cause: the host's CI (GitHub Actions runner) churns thousands of transient systemd units (user@<uid>, user-runtime-dir@<uid>, bunker-docker-* test agents); each cycle emits systemd1 Manager signals (UnitRemoved, NFailedUnits PropertiesChanged with NFailedUnits peaking at 2351). logind subscribes to systemd1 Manager signals, and its dispatch loop saturates: strace on logind showed ~3700 epoll iterations in 12s draining the systemd1 socket fd, with ~300Hz signal density. Fix applied: systemctl reset-failed (cleared 92 failed units) then systemctl restart systemd-logind; verified bunker_logind_up=1 via node_exporter textfile gauge and instant two-arg busctl property gets. Durable fix: reduce CI transient-unit churn or offload the runner from the shared host. PITFALL (probe bug): 'busctl introspect org.freedesktop.login1' WITHOUT the object path is an invalid invocation (introspect needs service + object); its nonzero rc false-positives as wedged. Correct probes: two-arg 'busctl introspect org.freedesktop.login1 /org/freedesktop/login1', 'busctl get-property org.freedesktop.login1 /org/freedesktop/login1 org.freedesktop.login1.Manager NCurrentSessions', or loginctl list-sessions.
